title: Turkiye Scholarships (Turkiye Burslari) 2027
overview: Government scholarship for bachelor's, master's and PhD study in Turkiye, with a free online application. The 2027 dates are not yet on the official site.
deadline_text: Official application calendar (2 November 2026): 'General Application Period: January 10 – February 20' (no year given); evaluation March to April; interviews April to June; results early August. The official 2026 announcement gave 10 January to 20 February 2026. No 2027 announcement is published yet.
expected_next_cycle: The official calendar lists the general application period as 10 January to 20 February (no year given), matching the 2026 cycle. 2027 dates not announced as of 19 October 2026.
funding_details: Official 'Why Türkiye Scholarships?' page: 'Apply now to get a fully funded and, high-quality education in Türkiye!'; the scholarship covers tuition fees, a one-year Turkish language course, accommodation, a once-off flight ticket and health insurance, and pays a monthly stipend
Monthly stipend: 6,500 TL (associate and bachelor's), 9,500 TL (master's), 13,000 TL (PhD); doubled for the merit scholarship
Accommodation: master's and doctoral students may stay in a dormitory in the first year, then rent with a housing allowance of 6,000 TL (Istanbul, Ankara) or 5,000 TL (other cities)
Awardees without a C1 Turkish certificate attend a one-year Turkish course, including those placed in English-medium programmes
participation_fee: None: the online application is free according to the earlier reading; no fee appears on the official pages read
stipend: 9,500 TL a month at master's level (6,500 TL bachelor's, 13,000 TL PhD), as stated on the official page; amounts in Turkish lira
eligibility: Citizens of all countries; Turkish citizens and people who lost Turkish citizenship are ineligible
Graduates, or those who will graduate at the end of the current academic year (before August)
Master's programmes: under 30 years of age; PhD under 35
Minimum academic achievement: 75% for graduate candidates (70% for associate and bachelor's candidates)
Not currently enrolled at the same level in a Turkish university
Language proof such as TOEFL or DELF only if the chosen university or programme requires it
Up to 12 programme choices in the online application system (TBBS); evaluation, then interviews
nationality_requirements: Citizens of all countries except Türkiye (official criteria page); the DRC is not excluded
age_requirement: Under 30 for master's programmes (official criteria page); the reference date is not stated on the page
education_requirement: A first degree (or graduating before August of the application year); at least 75% for graduate candidates
language_requirement: TOEFL, DELF or similar only if the programme requires it; a one-year Turkish course for awardees without C1 Turkish
application_process: Apply online in the Türkiye Scholarships application system (TBBS) during the general window (10 January to 20 February in the calendar)
Evaluation in March and April, interviews in April to June, results in early August

potential_issues: 2027 dates are not yet published; the calendar gives 10 January to 20 February without a year
Minimum 75% for graduate candidates; the degree grade is not recorded
Master's age limit under 30; the reference date is not stated

relevance_reason: Free application, full coverage and no work-experience requirement make it accessible; the subject match depends on the university programme chosen.
action: Check the official site in December 2026 for the 2027 announcement; the general window has been 10 January to 20 February.
